status: prospective engineering specification before estimation; not historical precommitment or independent approval

retirement.basis: unit-attributable unlevered nominal USD cash flow, not common equity
retirement.timing: calendar fiscal years; retirement at beginning of declared year, no generation in that year
retirement.ownership: gross plant MW and cash inputs multiplied once by evidenced ownership fraction
retirement.recovery: explicit gross unit cash schedule only; unrecovered book value is not a cash outflow
retirement.liability: decommissioning cash deducted at explicit payment year, never also deduct booked liability
retirement.replacement: explicit replacement power purchase expense or separately priced replacement capex, never an inferred free replacement
retirement.tax: explicit annual cash taxes; no inferred tax benefit
retirement.terminal: zero residual value must be declared; all recovery/decommissioning payments inside horizon
retirement.inversion: enumerate all declared integer retirement offsets; report every root within a predeclared monetary tolerance; no continuous interpolation of dates or market claim
retirement.uncertainty: declared deterministic scenarios only; no distribution or confidence claim

association.dependent: five-year nominal USD FCFE Gordon-implied annual growth, decimal fraction; same solver/settings identity across included observations
association.unit: one exact accepted issuer/security observation at a single declared cutoff
association.sample: explicit frozen issuer IDs, sector/region level sets and observation cutoff in the input manifest; no endogenous dropping or category selection
association.exposure: scope1+scope2 location-based tonnes CO2e / same-fiscal-period USD million revenue; scope3 excluded to avoid cross-company overlap; not a causal treatment
association.missingness: complete-case estimation with per-field exclusion reasons and unchanged full population denominator; no zero fill
association.availability: all sources published no later than cutoff, same observation date; reviewed exact identity required; unknown restatement/financial basis rejected
association.estimator: equal-weight OLS with explicit intercept, fixed first reference categories, standardized continuous regressors for numerical solving; coefficients transformed to original units
association.uncertainty: HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust covariance; two-sided Student-t 95% approximate intervals with n-p degrees of freedom; no causal inference
association.gates: n >= max(30, 3*p), full column rank, standardized design condition number <= 1e8, all hat diagonals < 1-1e-10; otherwise no estimates
association.diagnostics: coverage, omitted rows/reasons, n/p/df, rank, condition number, leverage, residuals, R2/adjustedR2, coefficient covariance
association.claim: conditional association only; not climate-attributable growth, market expectations, efficacy or causation
